seen.where: https://pares.cultura.gob.es/ParesBusquedas20/catalogo/description/3735700 (images 3, 11, 12, 20, 21, 24, 25, 26, 45, 55, 61 of 61 viewed 9 Nov 2026 at zoom 10, curl, 3.5 s spacing, no 429)
seen.extent: 61 images. No. 726 (image 3) and no. 728 (image 11) open in clear Spanish; cipher pages on image 12 (no. 728 continues), images 21-26 (no. 746, Vienna 14 Sep 1837, 'Muy Sor. mio:' then cipher at once), 25 (2nd pliego), 55 and neighbours (no. 747). About 14-15 lines of 18-24 letters per page, i.e. roughly 250-350 letters a page over dozens of pages (several thousand letters). Image 20 is an envelope; image 45 is a clear closing page (Viena 14 Sept 1837, signed El Conde de la Alcudia, addressed to Arias Teijeiro); image 61 is the end of no. 747 (Viena 15 Sept 1837) in clear with a pasted French newspaper cutting about the marquis de Villa-Franca and the marquis del Monasterio.
seen.cipher: Single Latin letters in cursive, no word spaces, no digits or symbols on the pages seen; x, g, b, l, p, s, m, e, i, q frequent, x often in clusters (nulls or word breaks, untested). Pages are written whole in cipher, or begin in clear and switch (no. 728: clear opening on image 11, cipher on image 12). Seen on every cipher leaf: no interlinear gloss, marginal plaintext, key table or decipherment on or with the leaves (offset ink on the versos is only bleed-through of the same pages).

prior_art.decode: Not found on DECODE: known.py (shelfmark, Alcudia, Arias Teijeiro, Sierra) finds only the sweep rows and this lead; a web search combining DECODE/de-crypt.org with Carlist 1837, Alcudia and Vienna returned only DECODE general papers (Heder & Megyesi 2022); the live database needs a login and was not queried.
prior_art.tomokiyo: No Cryptiana post on Carlist-war or Alcudia ciphers found (searches for Tomokiyo/cryptiana with Carlist and Alcudia returned nothing relevant).
prior_art.lasry: No Lasry paper or GL.htm entry on Carlist-war or 1830s Spanish diplomatic ciphers found in the same searches.
prior_art.edition: No edition of the letters found. Bullon de Mendoza, 'Don Carlos y el conde de la Alcudia', Aportes 1995 (repositorioinstitucional.ceu.es) prints Carlos's and Maria Teresa's letters to Alcudia, with a coded passage of 7 Dec 1838; it does not edit these 1837 letters from Alcudia.
prior_art.literature: Searches on Alcudia's Vienna mission (conde de la Alcudia, Carlist envoy at Vienna, Metternich's distrust of Carlist agents) found only the Bullon de Mendoza article and general Carlist diplomacy studies; no study mentions a decipherment of the 1837 AHN Diversos-Colecciones 161 cipher.

2425.key_check: No key held in the repo or on DECODE for Alcudia or the Carlist Secretaria de Estado. The same-legajo cipher letters N.2 (Azuares, lead 2421) and N.5 (Villafranca, lead 2422) are other correspondents' texts and no key is on their leaves, so none was tried. Not tried: a cryptanalytic solve (vetting only).
2425.key_in_volume: None seen in N.1. Cipher letters of other correspondents in the same legajo (N.2, N.5) were not tested as a shared system; whether Alcudia used one system with the Carlist office is unknown.
2425.duplicates: known.py on 'DIVERSOS-COLECCIONES,161,N.1', 'Alcudia', 'Arias Teijeiro', 'Sierra': only this lead and sweep files (Sierra hits are unrelated Lima/Sierra Leone entries). Not a duplicate of leads 2421-2424 (different correspondent and unit). Image 61 mentions Villa-Franca, the same Villafranca as lead 2422 (St Petersburg mission): related context, not the same text.
2425.cribs: Clear letters no. 726 (image 3: acknowledges Arias's despatches of 11-12 of the month from the Real de Estella, the king's health, Sebastian's headquarters) and the clear opening of no. 728 (image 11: thanks for the king's favour, answers despatch of 11th from the Real de Estella, replying to Alcudia's no. 727) show the same correspondence thread and dates, so the cipher passages sit among the same news. Whether the cipher text repeats the news of the clear letters 726/727/744/745 was not checked (cipher not read); 744/745 text not examined beyond image 45's closing page. This is crib context, not a tested crib.
